Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

You open your hand as if offering a secret. A small, bright figure steps from the space between your fingers.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One visible unoccupied placement within 3 squares that fits the chosen form's entire footprint.
Type
Magic / Summoning

Choose one Fey entry from the summon selection with a minimum tier of 1 or lower. Call one instance using its summon profile. Choose the form anew each casting. It remains for one scene.
